description.narrative: Mai Chau District Women’s Union proposes a solution in contributing to the enforcement of crime and law violation prevention under the circumstance that high record of social issues and crimes related to women and children has been reported in recent years. Issues such as drug deals, marriage and family cases, as well as child marriage and minor’s birth giving are the topical problem in the area of Mai Chau. Henceforth, the objective of this initiative is to improve legal knowledge on relevant laws (suchas gender equality, prevention and combat against domestic violence, marriage <(>&<)> family, children, prevention and control of narcotic substances)for beneficiaries targeting women, children and ethnicity through media means. Besides, the women’s union alsoaims to enhance a tight collaboration between governmental agencies and residential community in establishing one group of action, including 8 groups of community action to implement the supporting tools composed of legal consultation <(>&<)> aid, and supervising/managing security issue within the local area. Furthermore, in order to create greater impact on the women, the project desires to organize and operate the model “Women with Law” in 8 hamlets to promote the role of women and their contribution to theproblem solving. The initiative also aims to collect opinions from the people regarding legal proposition and resolution on socio-economic development in locality draft and create a policy proposal on the implementation of documents under law. The outputofthis initiative are: 1 collaborative mechanism between governmental agencies and residential community (establishing 1 group of action, 8 group of community action), raising legal awareness for 10.000 people, provide legal consultation and support forat least 80% of the victims/potential group, 1 legal proposal, and operate “Women with Law” models across the district and introduce it to the entire province of Hoa Binh.

participating-org.narrative: Mai Chau district Women's Union, Hoa Binh Province is a socio-political organization that is under governance by the Hoa Binh Women’s Union and Vietnam Women’s Union that represents for the legal and righteous rights of the women, thriving for women’s developmentand gender equality specifically within Mai Chau district. The Women's Union performs the task of protecting the legitimate rights and interests of women and children, focusing on legal information and legal aid related to the Law on Gender Equality, Prevention and Combat against Domestic Violence, Marriage and Family, etc. Besides, the Union also participates in the district People's Jurors;directly defends for women and children rights in court; directly participates in propagating legal knowledge to the people. In addition, the organization has had a thick experience in conducting legal propagation through many interactive and creative forms, simultaneously welly cooperate with other governmental agencies to maximize the effectiveness and unanimity in contributing to the sustainable development of the locality…Especially, the Mai Chau district Women’s Union has had several experiences in participating and conducting project activities with Hoa Binh Women’s Union and the Justice Initiatives Facilitation Fund (JIFF) Secretariat - Oxfam in JIFF Call 1 and Call 3.
